entries.note: Full multi-platform port of the decompiled LEGO Island 1.1 with release assets and a video demo.
Full re-implementation of the RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 engine; release assets and demo screenshots.
Binary-targeted Wolfram Language subset interpreter; v4 reserves Class 0 for non-binary full reconstructions, and the README does not claim full compatibility.
Documented progress covers only the early chapters; keep at Class 1.
The README states the project will not fully remake the game; keep at Class 1.
No prebuilt binaries: the README documents a source build and a hosted WebAssembly demo. Without a downloadable artifact it stays below Class 0 and is marked Class 2.
